fields.notes: JESD204 fixes the lane electrical model (differential CML, AC-coupled, speed grades), the line coding, the framing-parameter ranges, and the bring-up/alignment timing. It does NOT impose PDK-specific SDC/floorplan constraints — SerDes PHY characterization and clock/SYSREF distribution are device/board-integrator concerns.
